scope: Existing static editorial portfolio and legacy guide/insight routes, excluding city-journey-articles.json. Read-only code/content audit; no DB, browser, publication or external fact certification.
method: Loaded the runtime EDITORIAL_PORTFOLIO through the repository TypeScript loader, reviewed resolved bodies (including research expansions), grouped same-slug EN/KO and manually matched seven Chinese equivalents, and checked actual next.config.ts redirects. Body length alone is never used as a quality decision.

crossPortfolioFindings.finding: Generic policy pages often omit the rule they promise; material rule, rate, effective date, deadline and worked example must come from the cited official source rather than outsourcing the answer to readers.

Do not treat old fixed extracts as stale errors solely because a newer snapshot exists. Label observation windows and update a historical article only with reproducible new calculations; distinguish the publication date from data period.
Claims about catch-up, affordability, absorption or cause need comparable cohorts or separate explanatory evidence. Merely adding another caveat does not fill the evidentiary gap.
Eight Chinese portfolio records are initial short stubs, not equivalent translations of current English/Korean depth. Several translationGroupId values do not match their EN canonical equivalents.

Long monthly/budget reports contain useful tables and legitimate method. Move full data and reproducibility notes beneath the main finding; do not delete counts, filters, thresholds or calculation assumptions to meet an arbitrary word limit.

portfolio-builders.ts labels every initial record verified, uses a fixed review date and a launch revision statement; this metadata is not proof of a contemporary source check or identifiable human review.

scripts/audit-editorial-portfolio.mjs has historical classifications that disagree with actual redirects: e.g. compare-seoul-district-prices is filtered from runtime and its route merges into read-seoul-sale-transactions. Inventory should follow runtime plus redirects.
Recurring internal prose such as installed release/parser/display rights/evidence boundary belongs in source/method notes; reader-facing lead should state the finding and consequence.
